blocks.text: Outer Cape Music Festival 2026 Returns to Wellfleet Labor Day Weekend

blocks.html:
Looking for one of the best Labor Day Weekend events on Cape Cod? The Outer Cape Music Festival returns to Wellfleet Pier on Saturday, September 5 and Sunday, September 6, 2026, bringing two days of live music, local talent, food, and community together for a great cause.

With performances from nationally recognized artists, rising regional bands, and local favorites, the festival has become one of the premier live music events on the Outer Cape. Even better, 100% of all festival profits benefit local charities (see list below), making it a weekend that supports both great music and the Cape Cod community.

Saturday’s headliner, Electro Gix, delivers an energetic blend of classic rock, dance hits, pop favorites, and crowd-pleasing anthems that keep audiences on their feet. Known throughout New England for their high-energy performances, Electro Gix is a festival favorite that brings excitement from the first song to the encore.

Sharing the stage throughout the day are an impressive lineup of talented regional musicians, including:

  • 40 Thieves and Friends
  • The Boston Naturals
  • Natalia Bonfini Band
  • Club 9 Ball
  • Matt Devlin

Together, these artists offer a mix of rock, blues, Americana, soul, and original music that showcases the incredible talent found throughout Cape Cod and New England.

The Sunday lineup features an outstanding collection of Cape Cod musicians and regional favorites, including:

  • Crooked Coast
  • Bar Maids
  • Kami Lyle and Friends featuring Joey and Johnny Spampinato, Barbara Blazedell, and Tim Utt
  • Watch Your Step

From reggae and rock to blues, Americana, and contemporary originals, Sunday’s lineup offers something for music lovers of every age.

Beyond the performances, the Outer Cape Music Festival offers a vibrant waterfront atmosphere where visitors can enjoy local food, refreshments, and the unique charm of historic Wellfleet Harbor.

Whether you’re a Cape Cod local or visiting for Labor Day Weekend, the festival is an excellent opportunity to experience the region’s thriving music scene while supporting local nonprofit organizations.

blocks.text: Make a Weekend of It in Wellfleet

blocks.html:
Labor Day Weekend is one of the best times to visit the Outer Cape. Before or after the festival, spend time exploring Wellfleet’s beautiful beaches, art galleries, local shops, restaurants, and scenic harbor.

If you’re 21 or older, stop by Cape Cod Cannabis, conveniently located just minutes from Wellfleet Pier. Our knowledgeable team is happy to help you explore premium flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vape products, concentrates, tinctures, CBD products, and more before enjoying the weekend’s festivities. Please consume responsibly and always follow Massachusetts cannabis laws.

The Outer Cape Music Festival 2026 promises an unforgettable weekend of live entertainment, community spirit, and charitable giving in one of Cape Cod’s most beautiful waterfront settings.

Mark your calendar for September 5 & 6, 2026, gather your friends and family, and experience one of the best live music festivals on Cape Cod.

For tickets and additional festival information, visit outercapemusicfest.com.

blocks.text: 100% of festival profits are donated to charity.

blocks.html:
The 2026 beneficiaries are:

  • Lower Cape Outreach Council – Provides emergency food, clothing, financial assistance, and long-term self-sufficiency programs for residents of the eight Lower Cape towns.
  • The Eastham/Orleans Elks Veterans Fund – Supports veterans, active military members, and their families through programs focused on employment, housing, health care, education, and military family assistance.
  • The Lily House (Wellfleet) – A nonprofit community home that provides compassionate hospice and end-of-life care for terminally ill residents and support for their families.
  • Friends of the Eastham Council on Aging – The Way Home Fund – Helps fund senior center programs, fitness classes, meals, transportation, educational opportunities, and other services for older adults in the Eastham community.
  • Outer Cape Music Scholarship – Provides local children with access to music education by helping cover the cost of instruments and music lessons for families in need.
  • Boston Children’s Hospital – Supports pediatric care, medical research, and family-centered services. The festival organizers note this charity holds special personal significance to their family.
  • Wellfleet Food Pantry – Helps combat food insecurity by providing groceries and essential food supplies to Wellfleet residents and families experiencing hardship.

These local and regional organizations reflect the festival’s mission of supporting the Outer Cape community while celebrating live music. Attending the festival not only offers a weekend of entertainment but also helps fund programs that provide food assistance, veteran services, hospice care, senior programs, music education, and pediatric healthcare.

blocks.html:

Before heading to Wellfleet Pier, stop by Cape Cod Cannabis at 1446 US-6 in the South Wellfleet Shopping Center, conveniently located just minutes from the festival. Explore one of Cape Cod’s largest selections of premium flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vape products, concentrates, tinctures, CBD products, and accessories. Whether you’re visiting Cape Cod for the weekend or you’re a local attending the festival, our knowledgeable team is here to help you find the products that best fit your preferences.
